summary: Draw one half of a symmetrical icon, press Shift Command M, and the other half appears reflected about the middle of the frame, exact to the unit, picked and one undo away. Beside icon-draw-wt.html step 7: the shoulder at 9, 10 is copied to 15, 10.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walks: mirror-across-center-walk and mirror-across-center-right-click-walk.

try.do: Layer > New Frame, pick 24 in Icons, Add Frame.
Draw a circle and set it to X 6, Y 7, W 6, H 6 in Position and Size (Option Command P).
Press Command Z, then pick the circle and choose Mirror Across Center from the three dots on the Layers header.
Right click the circle and choose Mirror Across Center.
Switch to the light appearance and look at both shoulders and the picked one.
Name a shape "Wing left" and mirror it: the copy is called "Wing right".
Open a video: Shift Command M still goes to the previous marker, and Mirror is not in the Layer menu.

evaluate: Is the middle of the frame the line you expected the copy to reflect about, rather than the middle of the shape or the canvas?
Is it right that the copy, not the original, ends up picked?
Is Layer > Mirror Across Center, right under Duplicate Layer, where you would look for it in the menu bar?
Should a shadow on the copy stay cast the same way (it does now), or flip with the shape?
rough: The mock's Layers menu also draws Center on the artboard, Union and Outline stroke under Mirror Across Center; none is in the panel menu yet. Filed as the-layers-panel-menu-carries-the-icon-mock-s-ce.
The mock prints Center on the artboard on Option Command C; that key stays Canvas Size (Photoshop parity), and the-layers-panel-menu-carries-the-icon-mock-s-ce must pick another key or ask.
The copy's name matches the mock: "Shoulder left" mirrors to "Shoulder right". A shape the app named ("Ellipse") mirrors to "Ellipse 2", as a duplicate does.
Pictures and text are mirrored by flipping them, so mirrored words read backwards, as a reflection does in any drawing app.
Not offered on a video at all: there Shift Command M is Go to Previous Marker, and a copy would carry its movement unreflected.
The panel menu opens to the right of its three dots and runs past the window edge in the walk's picture; that is how the Layers menu has always opened, not new here.
